title: doryphora aromatica
intro: Doryphora aromatica, commonly known as Wollemi Pine, is a rare and ancient plant species that is native to Australia. The health benefits of Doryphora aromatica include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage.
